chunks: Paradise will be brought near to the God-conscious.

key_terms.لِلْمُتَّقِينَ: To the God-conscious (those who practice taqwa)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for the Muttaqin (God-conscious) according to Surah Ash-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the eschatological reward for the Muttaqin, often interpreted as the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers, emphasizing that divine proximity is earned through spiritual vigilance. The imagery of Paradise being 'brought close' signifies not just physical nearness but the fulfillment of the soul's ultimate desire for union with the Divine, a concept deeply rooted in the tradition of the Imams.
